lines.text: Everyone in the yard has stopped sleeping. The stone is humming. I can feel it in my forelimbs.
Master Voll said the Span is too perfect. I wrote that on the wall in chalk. He made me rub it out. Then he copied it.
Nobody sings about it. That is the point, is it? I did not understand until now.
It stood. But the yard went quiet when you walked past. I did too.
You held it alone. I took the third pier. Next time, call me sooner.
